# Step 3b — first SH seismograms: PREM, deep point force $f_y=1$ at the pole, receivers on φ = 0 every 10°

* **Source**: point force at the north pole, depth 590 km (just above the 600 km discontinuity at r = 5771 km), $f_y = f_\phi(\theta=0,\phi=0) = 1$ at **every** ω (flat spectrum); a vertical $f_z$ would excite no SH at all, $f_x$ no SH on φ = 0.
* **Expansion**: fully normalised $\mathbf C_{lm}$, $|m|\le 2$ (exact for any source on the polar axis: force |m| ≤ 1, moment tensor |m| ≤ 2); here only m = ±1 are non-zero.
  $c_{lm}=\mathbf f\cdot\mathbf C^*_{lm}(\theta_s,\phi_s)$, radial $K_\xi(\Omega,l)\,G_l=-X(\xi_s)/R$, $\;u(\theta,0)=\sum_l G_l(R)\sum_m c_{lm}\mathbf C_{lm}(\theta,0)$.
* **Radial system**: PREM outer solid region (CMB and surface traction-free, exact for SH), uniform h per zone, interfaces = one shared node where the two
  half-element rows are **added** (continuity of W and of traction; flexOPT: native clipped p = 2 rows, i.e. the additive form of the overlap). Built once
  per scheme from three basis matrices (linearity in the materials): $K=\Omega^2T-H_L-(\Lambda-2)H_N$.
* **Time domain**: DSM complex frequency $\omega-i\omega_I$, $\omega_I=-\ln(10^{-2})/t_{len}$, $t_{len}=3276.8$ s, $f\le f_{max}=0.05$ Hz,
  $l_{max}(\omega)\approx\omega R/3\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}+30$; inverse transform after all frequencies, × $e^{\omega_I t}$; a cosine taper on the top 20 % of the band
  (`taper=0` gives the raw flat-spectrum response).
* **Schemes**: conventional DSM (h = 10 km), OPT3 and OPT5 (h = 10 km, OPT3 rows next to the ends for OPT5), and conventional DSM at h = 2.5 km as reference.

include(joinpath(flexopt_root, "helpers", "sphericalTI_SH_step3b.jl"))
prem = planet1D.getSet1Dmodel!(:PREM)
Rprem = prem.averagedPlanetRadiusInKilometer
gridSeis = shRadialGrid(prem; mode=:uniform, h=10.0)
gridRef  = shRadialGrid(prem; mode=:uniform, h=2.5)
for s in gridSeis.segments
    @printf("zone %2d: %7.1f – %7.1f km, %4d intervals, h = %6.3f km\n", s.zone, s.r[1], s.r[end], length(s.r) - 1, s.h_km)
end
srcDepth = 590.0
rsSeis = Rprem - srcDepth

seisTraces = Dict(k => shTimeSeries(sp; np=4096, taper=0.2) for (k, sp) in seisSpectra)
function plotRecordSection(traces, θdeg; keys=("DSMconv_ref", "DSMconv", "OPT3", "OPT5"), tmax=2000.0, title="")
    fig = Figure(size=(1100, 900))
    ax = Axis(fig[1, 1]; xlabel="time (s)", ylabel="epicentral distance (°)", title="SH (u_φ), f_y = 1 at 590 km, PREM " * title)
    ref = traces[first(keys)]
    sel = ref.t .<= tmax
    scale = 4.0 / maximum(abs.(ref.traces[sel, :]))
    colors = (:black, :orange, :dodgerblue, :crimson)
    for (ik, k) in enumerate(keys)
        tr = traces[k]
        for (ir, θ) in enumerate(θdeg)
            lines!(ax, tr.t[sel], θ .+ scale .* tr.traces[sel, ir]; color=colors[ik], linewidth=ik == 1 ? 2 : 1,
                   label=ir == 1 ? k : nothing)
        end
    end
    axislegend(ax; position=:rb)
    display(fig); return fig
end
plotRecordSection(seisTraces, seisSpectra["DSMconv_ref"].θdeg)

# misfit of each scheme to the fine-grid DSM reference (same time window, all receivers)
let ref = seisTraces["DSMconv_ref"], sel = ref.t .<= 2000.0
    for k in ("DSMconv", "OPT3", "OPT5")
        tr = seisTraces[k]
        e = norm(tr.traces[sel, :] .- ref.traces[sel, :]) / norm(ref.traces[sel, :])
        @printf("%-8s (h = 10 km) vs DSMconv (h = 2.5 km): relative L2 misfit = %.3e\n", k, e)
    end
end
